summary: Implemented the progress file-reading feature without running any repository code. Changes: rich/progress.py gains a private _ProgressReader (RawIOBase + BinaryIO) and _ProgressReaderContext, module-level open (with overloads) and wrap_file, and Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file methods. tests/test_progress.py gains 14 new tests placed before the script-entry block. docs/source/progress.rst gains "Reading from a file" and "Reading from a file-like object" subsections under Advanced usage. CHANGELOG.md gains one Unreleased/Added entry linking PR 1759. The diff is additive only (855 insertions, 0 deletions), nothing is committed. Tests, black, and mypy were not run; verification was by reading. Judgment calls to review: sys is imported for the version-gated Literal; readinto uses a cast to io.BufferedIOBase because typing.BinaryIO lacks readinto; mode 'tr' returns a binary reader per spec; other text-mode buffering values pass through to the byte handle; the handle is closed if TextIOWrapper construction fails; the wrap_file-without-total test uses setattr to set total to None.
